title: Cost of survey.
officialText:
Any costs incurred by the city in connection with the survey shall become money due and owing to the city as part of the return of precept and judgment provided for in sections 28-216.9, 28-216.10 and 28-216.11 or pursuant to lien provided for in section 28-112.9.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
